verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents its own automated payment reminders, which is the core of a dunning sequence. The pack gives no detail on configuring reminder sequences, and branded templates are documented for invoices rather than reminder emails. missing for 10: configurable multi-step dunning sequence details, branded reminder email templates, in-app banners, grace periods, final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: automate payment reminders with Zoho Invoice
